name: fc-backtest-ui-harness
description: DB-free, browser-driven test harness for the Backtesting UI (js/backtest.js, js/backtest-drawings.js). Copies app/ to a temp dir, stubs auth + the API, vendors the two CDN chart libs locally, serves it with php -S, and drives it with Playwright. See setup.js for the exact recipe. Lives outside app/ -- never deployed.
